repairs: Data queue create failure releases the newly reserved ring.
Pool reservation failure deletes the newly created queue and releases ring reservation.
Pool create failure deletes the newly created queue and releases both reservations; pool-active metadata is cleared.
Successful queue destruction delegates to repaired typed destroy_queue, not the mismatched stock tail slot.
